_He exhaled an extremely good smell, and his multi-colored hair tied in a bun and his large loose fringes almost covering his face, He threw himself on the couch, letting out a tired moan. His mind running in thought if his boyfriend had already arrived from university, he even thought about sending a message, but he didn't want to bother his boyfriend._
